Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation plan and benchmark success criteria (ACME)

Alex -- thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned on the MAP milestone for the technical evaluation. I pulled together a draft MAP and a short benchmark spec (attached). High-level: 

- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for ACME's knowledge-base Q&A workload at expected latency and cost while meeting quality thresholds.
- Target close for this MAP milestone: May 14, 2027 (aiming to complete evaluation within 4 weeks).
- Success criteria (proposal):
  • Mean p95 generation latency (90 tokens): <= 220ms per request (region: us-west).
  • Cost target: <= $0.38 per 1k tokens served at projected concurrency (50 rps sustained).
  • QA/quality: F1 >= 0.78 on the ACME evaluation set and no more than 2% hallucination rate on factual recall checks.
  • Throughput: sustain 50 rps with <= 3s tail latency for 99% of requests.

- Model shortlist (initial): Llama-3-8B-rlhf-32k (quantized), Mistral-Instruct-7B, Redwood-optimized Llama-3-13B (fp16). We'll finalize after a quick micro-benchmark.

- Dependencies & responsibilities:
  • ACME: provide evaluation dataset (sample queries + ground-truth) and SSO account for test env - due Apr 14. (Alex/Priya)
  • Redwood (Camila/SE): prepare test environment, run baseline benchmarks, share scripts - due Apr 18. (Camila/Mateo)
  • Joint: sync on evaluation rubric and final model list - meeting Apr 16 11am PT.

I've attached the MAP draft and a short benchmark-specs spreadsheet with measurement definitions. Please confirm the dates above and the model shortlist or suggest changes.

Thanks - Camila
